content: उपकारः .²1 Service, help, assistance, favour, kindness, obligation (<ab>opp.</ab> अपकार); अशक्यो द्रव्यपदार्थिकेन द्रव्यस्य गुणकृत उपकारः प्रतिज्ञातुम् <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls>P. II. 1. 1</ls>. उपकारापकारौ हि लक्ष्यं लक्षणमेतयोः <ls>Śi. 2. 37</ls>; शाम्येत्प्रत्यपकारेण नोपकारेण दुर्जनः <ls>Ku. 2. 40</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">3. 73</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 284</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 22</ls>; उपकारे वृत् to be of service or useful (to another); .²2 Preparation. .²3 Ornament, decoration. .²4 Particularly, flowers, garlands <ab>&c.</ab> suspended at gate-ways as embellishments on festive occasions. .{@-री@} .²1 A royal tent, palace. .²2 Caravansera.
